_about: Eligibility rules as data, read by relocaitor/visas/eligibility.py (Python) and preview/mock_api.js (browser). Each visa rule compares one visa field with one profile field. Tests: 'in' (profile value must be in the visa's list), 'at_least' / 'at_most' (profile number against the visa's limit), 'allowed' (fails when the visa says false and the profile says yes), 'flag' (fails whenever the visa field is true). A rule is skipped when the visa field is absent (or 0 with ignore_zero). 'missing' applies when the profile field is unknown. Outcomes: 'ineligible' always wins; 'conditional' only downgrades an eligible verdict. Text placeholders: {visa}, {profile}, {visa:usd}, {profile:usd}, {visa:fields}.

blocs.name: EU/EEA free movement
blocs.summary: As an EU/EEA/Swiss citizen you can live and work here without a visa; register locally after 3 months. Permanent residence after 5 years.

blocs.name: Common Travel Area
blocs.summary: British and Irish citizens can live, work and study in each other's country with no visa and near-equal rights.

blocs.name: Trans-Tasman arrangement
blocs.summary: Australian and New Zealand citizens can live and work in each other's country on arrival.

blocs.name: GCC citizen mobility
blocs.summary: Gulf Cooperation Council citizens can live and work across member states without a work visa.

blocs.name: Mercosur Residence Agreement
blocs.summary: South American citizens of member states get 2-year residence with work rights, convertible to permanent residence.
